text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, while strolling near a park, I
see Gold
City in the middle of a photo
shoot.

text_block_list.name: Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Okay, let's take ten! City, please make
sure to
rest up!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Got it.

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
Here, I packed you lunch, so eat up. Tell
me if
you're feeling the slightest bit
unwell, okay?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, yeah, I will.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Sigh. She's been such a helicopter manager lately. I ended up relying on her to handle my meals too...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
(This lunch box is massive... Was she
just, like,
cooking up a storm between
my gigs? Hah, that's
crazy...)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
(Well, it's not like I can make my own
food or anything... No matter how many
cookbooks I go
through, my cooking
never gets any better.)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you're that trainer from school... No,
it's
nothing big. Just thought it's about
time I look
after myself.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: If it's something you're not good ...
If it's something you're not good ...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I tell her that though it takes courage to
rely on
others, there's much to be
gained in doing so.

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
City, are you done eating? How's your
stomach
doing?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'm done, and my stomach's fine.
Anyway, I
ate the whole thing. Thanks
for making it.

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
You sure you're okay? You tend to hold
back a lot... If you have any concerns
about your meals, I
can always make
some arrangements for you.

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
Aside from just making you lunch, I've
been looking into ordering dinner
deliveries for you on
shoot days too,
so...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: It's okay, you don't need to do all that.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I mean, I have been thinking about my
meals...
But I'm not, like, stressing over it
or anything.

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text: So you are worried about your meals! Don't worry, I can handle this—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: No, listen! It's not like that!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
(Nothing will change if I let her do all
the work.
But then again... I'm in no
position to fix things by
myself.)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
(There's much to be gained in relying on
others,
huh? Well, if that's true...)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...The thing is, I want to be able to make
my own
meals.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
So instead of cooking for me... Well, I
was
wondering if you could teach me
how to cook.

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text: City...

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! I'd be happy to do that. We can
hold the
cooking lessons at my house.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
During my lunch break, I spot Gold City
looking
around for someone to help her
out.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Hey, Yukino! Do you have a second?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Munch, munch... Mmm! This's sup'r yummy, City! The sausages are grilled t'perfection!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...That's a relief.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...That's a relief.
choice_data_list: Did you improve after learning fro...
Relying on others is fine once in ...
Relying on others is fine once in ...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Yeah, I guess I was. She's given me
a few
lessons.
choice_data_list: Did you improve after learning fro...
Relying on others is fine once in ...
Relying on others is fine once in ...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Mm, yeah. Even for my standards, I'd say
this
tastes pretty good.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
(It's important to do the best you can in
life...
But, I guess it's also important to
ask for help
when you need it.)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, you might be right about that.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
(I've got to practice more if I'm ever
going to
cook my own meals.)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
This is seriously so yummy! I didn't know
city
lunches tasted this good! This brings
a tear t'my
eye, it does!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Pfft. Come on, calm down and eat your
food.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
(It'd be cool to keep the lessons going.
Getting Yukino's opinion on my cooking
every now and
then might be a good
idea.)
